articles.title: From Buc-ee's to BBQ: World Cup Tourists Find Unexpected Joy in Everyday America
articles.summary: A Japanese fan's viral post about Texas Roadhouse bread sparked a wave of World Cup visitors sharing their love for American quirks—from Walmart to yellow school buses—offering a surprising soft-power boost amid global tensions.

articles.title: Trump's Blue Reflecting Pool Turns Green—Scientists Say It Was Inevitable
articles.summary: Days after a Trump-ordered repaint, the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool turned green from algae. Experts call it 'New Pond Syndrome' and blame the dark bottom, heat, and stagnant water—a recurring problem since 1922.

articles.title: Meloni Accuses Trump of Fabricating 'Begging' Story, Italy Cancels Diplomatic Visit
articles.summary: Italian PM Giorgia Meloni says Trump lied about her begging for a photo at the G7, calling his claim 'completely fabricated.' Italy's foreign minister canceled a U.S. trip, and officials invoked WWII sacrifices in a sharp diplomatic escalation.
